title: Chaligny's method book and his brass band
summary: Chaligny taught from a real music book, recommended a clarinet book, and had a brass band that rehearsed at the Scent of Sinners club.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Learning your horn: teachers, lessons and fees

blocks.x: He teach me out of a music book. A real music book. Not the regular music book then. But, he was teaching me out of a book he had around then. So, after I got to making my scales so good, so he recommended me to get a clarinet book. Oto Lange clarinet book. Oh, yeah. Oh, yeah. So, gee, I was playing up some music in that clarinet book. The scales, you know, chromatic scales, ascending and descending. I was doing all that. And then, I used to play in a brass band with him. He had a brass band. He had a son who used to lead the band. And Sean Lee always was there, giving us ideas how to play. We used to rehearse at the... Scent of Sinners. Yeah. On Demain Street. Scent of Sinners Club. Yeah.
Uh-huh. We used to rehearse there.
And, so... Is that a dance band or a brass band? It was a brass band. Uh-huh. Yes.
